test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 03 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A cylindrical rod has an outer curved surface area of 7700 cm² . If the length of the rod is 95 cm, then the outer radius (in cm) of the rod, correct to two places of decimal, is: (Take π = (22)/(7))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** of a cylinder = 2πrh

Given: **CSA** = 7700 cm², **h (length)** = 95 cm

Direct calculation: r = 7700 ÷ (2 × 22/7 × 95)

r = (7700 × 7) ÷ (44 × 95) = 12.8947... cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12.89 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Outer **Curved Surface Area** = 7700 cm²

**Length (height)** of the rod (h) = 95 cm

**Formula Used:**

CSA of **Cylindrical Rod** = 2πrh

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/529e38acf6bd984a02ebc40be3d3add78be0072321f62845428e12cd39375fe3.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 7700 = 2 × (22/7) × r × 95

⇒ 7700 = (44/7) × 95 × r

⇒ r = (7700 × 7) ÷ (44 × 95)

⇒ r = 53900 ÷ 4180

⇒ r = 5390 ÷ 418

⇒ r ≈ 12.8947 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 12.89 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cylinder

It includes the curved area and the area of two circular bases: TSA = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of Cylinder

The total space occupied by the cylinder is given by the formula: Volume = πr²h.

Hollow Cylinder

For a pipe with outer radius R and inner radius r, the material volume is πh(R² − r²).</p
